v3_focus: v2 색·타입·시그니처 1픽셀 변경 없이 계승 + 10 슬라이드 카테고리(cover/agenda/section/key-message/chart/diagram/cards/comparison/narrative/closing)를 원본 71페이지에 1:1 mirror 매핑 + 24 시각 어휘 사전

color_taboo: saturated green outside p-07 ∞ right lobe

type.korean_fallback: 'Pretendard Black', 'Pretendard ExtraBold', 'Noto Sans KR Black', sans-serif
type.weight_rule: 한글·영문 모두 Bold(700) 이상이 기본. Light/Regular 한글 절대 사용 금지. 단 차트 축 라벨·출처 캡션·페이지 번호는 Regular OK.

cover_title.note: 표지 p-01 / 종료 p-71 모두 흰색 — 사이안 아님

chapter_slate_english.case: Title Case (다단어, p-08 양식) 또는 ALL CAPS (단단어, p-02/p-58 양식)

kpi_numeral_giant.note: p-18 key-message 거대 KPI는 흰색 — 사이안 아님

kpi_unit_trailing.note: 거대 숫자 옆 단위(만대/조/%/백만톤)는 숫자의 30~35% 크기, baseline-align

kpi_numeral_card.note: p-64 카드 enumerator 01~07 — SOLID fill (outline 절대 금지)

shape.chevron_stack_count: 3-5 nested right-pointing > shapes, stroke 8-20px depending on size
shape.chevron_glow: inner V-vertex #F5FBFF white-cyan → mid #00B0F0 → outer #101030 fade

chart.type_match: trend=line(p-48, with optional area-fill 15-30% opacity + chevron-tab stage band above), comparison=column(few 4-7), share=donut(<=3 segments, mild isometric pedestal allowed per p-16), single-kpi=giant white numeral + small unit, stacked=tonal-cyan-stack(top #66FFFF / mid #00D3FD / base #0060A8 — NEVER rainbow), multi-region=line + paired-bar callouts with flag pins(p-10), donut-trio-isometric=p-16
chart.axis: 0.75pt #1E2A52 x-baseline only; y-axis omitted; tick labels #A8B4C8 10-11pt
chart.gridline: none (or 0.5pt #1E2A52 horizontal hairlines at value markers, sparingly)
chart.value_label: 14-16pt Inter Bold tabular, on bar/vertex end, key value white; emphasized data #66FFFF or #00D3FD; gigantic 80-120pt overlay allowed for single hero KPI
chart.line: 2.5-3pt solid #00D3FD, white circle dots 6-8px with #00D3FD ring (NOT pure-cyan fill) at year markers; dotted-extension allowed for projection segments
chart.area_fill: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(0,211,253,0.30) 0%, rgba(0,211,253,0) 100%) under emphasized line — TASTEFUL gradient inside cyan family only
chart.donut: <=3 slices, emphasis #66FFFF or gradient #66FFFF→#00D3FD, passive #14274A, 0.75pt #101030 divider, center 80pt white numeral + 14pt label; mild isometric 'staircase pedestal' allowed (p-16 style — 3 donuts ascending on chamfered #14274A steps with #66FFFF top edge)
chart.stacked_bar: tonal cyan stack: top #66FFFF / mid #00D3FD / base #0060A8 — NEVER rainbow per category. Comparison baseline bar #3A4A6E (muted gray for past data)
chart.bar_corner: 0-2px radius, solid fill (NO gradient bar fill, NO bevel)
chart.stage_band_header: trapezoidal chevron-tabs above chart (3 tabs typical: 초기 > 성장기 > 성숙기, Upstream > Midstream > Downstream): active tab #66FFFF fill #101030 text, inactive #14274A fill #A8B4C8 text — Hyundai signature primitive (p-48/p-52)
chart.render: SVG precise, no border box, no legend box, no shadow, no rainbow
chart.source: bottom-right 9pt #A8B4C8 caption mandatory on data slides (e.g. 'Source: Bloomberg New Energy Finance')

diagram.language: 다크 네이비 무대 + 사이안 chevron + 헤어라인 골격 + 단일 사이안-블루 패밀리 그라디언트. 노드는 #14274A 면 + 1px #1E2A52 보더, 활성 요소만 #66FFFF border + cyan glow. NO rainbow, NO per-category color.
diagram.connector_straight: 1pt #1E2A52 solid hairline OR 1.5-2pt #66FFFF straight (for timeline arrow, p-65 left→right)
diagram.connector_curved: 1.5-2pt #66FFFF curved arc (for hub-spoke flow, p-35 card→vehicle) + filled triangle arrowhead 0.10in
diagram.chevron_corner_mark: miniaturized 3-stack chevron at top-left x=3%/y=4%, ~50px wide, white-cyan inner glow fading to #00B0F0; PRESENT on every Mode B page next to '2024 CEO Investor Day' header label
diagram.chevron_chapter_motif: 3-5 nested right-pointing > shapes on chapter-slate edge. Cover/closing (p-01/p-71): LEFT 5-stack ~80% canvas height (mirror = bookend). Single-word chapter slates (p-02/p-58): RIGHT 4-stack ~60% canvas height. Multi-word chapter slates (p-08/p-33/p-45): RIGHT 2-3 arcs + LEFT small starburst glow. Stroke 8-20px. Inner V-vertex #F5FBFF → mid #00B0F0 → outer fades to #101030
diagram.hyundai_way_infinity: SIGNATURE DIAGRAM (p-07 mirror). Two horizontal interlocking lobes forming ∞: LEFT lobe cyan-blue radial gradient (#0060A8→#002C5F with #66FFFF top inner glow) labeled 'MOBILITY GAME CHANGER' (ALL CAPS 22-26pt bold white inside) / RIGHT lobe teal-green radial gradient (#189078→#0E5645 with #66FFFF top inner glow) labeled 'ENERGY MOBILIZER' (ALL CAPS 22-26pt bold white inside). Crossing center labeled 'HYUNDAI DYNAMIC CAPABILITIES' in #66FFFF Title Case 22-24pt above infinity. Above the ∞: giant white 'HYUNDAI WAY' ALL CAPS 64-72pt. Position: center, y≈40-78%, width≈70% canvas. THIS IS THE DECK'S CONCEPTUAL ARCHITECTURE — must appear in diagram primary slot. ONLY 1 instance in entire deck. #189078 teal is used ONLY here.
diagram.chevron_tabbed_stage_band: Hyundai signature progress primitive (p-48/p-52 mirror). Horizontal row of 3 trapezoidal chevron tabs above a chart/table (active filled #66FFFF #101030 text; inactive filled #14274A #A8B4C8 text); each tab leads-into the next like > > >. Used for stage progressions (초기→성장기→성숙기, Upstream→Midstream→Downstream). y position ≈18-22%. Tab width = label text + 0.6in.
diagram.sub_chapter_split_panel: Mode C (p-17 mirror). LEFT 50% darkened blue-shifted photographic panel (factory aerial / battery pack / EV / hydrogen plant / autonomous vehicle), RIGHT 50% #101030 dark panel with English cyan eyebrow #66FFFF 14-18pt + Korean main title #FFFFFF 40-48pt + small chevron+glow corner accent. Diagonal soft transition (~80° vertical) between them.
diagram.kpi_hero_giant_white_plus_unit: p-18 mirror — key-message anchor. y=11% eyebrow Korean medium 14-16pt #FFFFFF + right-side brand wordmark lineup (HYUNDAI · GENESIS · NEXO). y=18-32% GIANT WHITE numeral 140-160pt + baseline-align unit 45-55pt (white, NOT cyan). y=42-58% 3 rounded pill cards row (#14274A fill, 16-20px round, 4:1 aspect, white bold Korean 18-22pt center, ≈2-3% gap). y=55-100% lower-half panoramic vehicle photo (Genesis sedan duo, IONIQ lineup, factory floor — wide shot, not close-up) at 60% opacity over bg.
diagram.card_enumerator_grid_asymmetric: p-64 mirror — cards anchor. 4+3 asymmetric 7-card grid (Row1 4 cards, Row2 3 cards centered). Each card: #101030 fill + 1px #14274A border OR #14274A solid, 8-12px radius, ≈6% padding, ≈18-20% width × ≈30-32% height. Top 1/3: GIANT CYAN numeral '01'~'07' (~80-100pt, #00B0F0~#66FFFF, SOLID FILL NOT outline). Optional cyan ring outline circle (~80px diameter, fill #101030, numeral inside). Middle: English/Korean header 2-3 words bold white 14-16pt centered. Bottom: body 11-12pt white 80% opacity 2-4 lines centered. NOTE: This is the ONLY place giant cyan numerals appear — NOT as chapter dividers.
diagram.card_3col_icon_bullet: p-26 mirror. 3 columns, ≈30% width, ≈3% gap. Each column: icon top 40-48px square (#14274A round tile + #66FFFF/#FFFFFF stroke), Korean category header bold 22-26pt #FFFFFF left-aligned, bullet list 5-7 items (· small cyan dot + Korean 13-14pt white 80%, line-height 1.6). NO per-column color differentiation. Background atmospheric (holographic person/factory/map) underlay ≤25% opacity allowed.
diagram.card_4col_kpi_band: p-04 mirror. 4 cards equal width ≈22%, ≈2% gap. Each card: transparent OR #14274A subtle fill, KPI numeral 64-72pt bold white + unit 22pt (e.g. '162.7조', '9.3%') baseline-aligned, label below Korean 14pt white 80%. Top eyebrow #66FFFF 14pt + Korean 22pt bold (e.g. ''23년 사상 최대 영업 성과 달성'). Multi-period 2-row OK ('23년 / '24년 2분기). Vehicle underlay below.
diagram.pill_row_3to4_short_label: p-18 lower half mirror. 3-4 rounded pills with ≤8-char Korean labels. Each pill #14274A fill, 16-20px round, 4:1~3:1 aspect, white bold 18-22pt center. ≈2-3% gap. NO icons. Use ONLY as auxiliary to KPI hero (not standalone).
diagram.narrative_4card_stack_plus_hero: p-09 mirror — narrative anchor. LEFT 60% 4-card vertical stack (EXACTLY 4 cards — not 3, not 5). Each card: #14274A fill or transparent + #14274A border, 6-8px radius, ≈3% padding. Card left: 40-48px square icon tile (#14274A round + #66FFFF/#FFFFFF stroke). Card right: header Korean bold 18-20pt #FFFFFF + body 12-13pt white 80% 1-2 lines. Active/featured card adds right thin #66FFFF 2px border. RIGHT 40%: industrial photo close-up (engine block, battery pack, factory detail — NOT panoramic), darkened, 50-70% opacity, BG blend, slight right-bleed. Top title 34pt bold white + subtitle 14pt white 80%.
diagram.three_circle_badge_row: p-69 mirror — closing secondary. 3 identical large circular badges across slide (each ~140-160px diameter / ≈25% canvas width). Each: #04599D~#0464AB fill + 2px #66FFFF outer ring + top small icon (#FFFFFF stroke) + center Korean bold 20pt #FFFFFF (e.g. '완성차'/'모빌리티'/'수소에너지') + bottom English 12pt #66FFFF (e.g. 'Hyundai Dynamic Capabilities'). Subtle vehicle/road photograph fades behind at ≤20% opacity. ≈4-6% gap between badges. NO per-badge color differentiation — all same fill.
diagram.values_4badge_radial_gradient: p-70 mirror — closing tertiary. 4 attribute circular badges horizontal (e.g. 'Safety & Quality' / 'Agility' / 'Tenacity' / 'Progress'). Each ~120-140px diameter, soft cyan radial gradient #66FFFF→#0060A8 fill, white stroke outline, top #FFFFFF stroke icon + bottom label English bold 14-16pt #FFFFFF. ≈3-4% gap. Above: giant English headline 'Be Bold and Tenacious for Customers' bold 48-56pt #FFFFFF centered.
diagram.central_hub_plus_radiating_callouts: p-67 mirror — comparison tertiary. Center hub: large rounded rectangle or circle, #0060A8 or #14274A fill + #66FFFF outline 2-3px, ≈25-30% canvas width, label inside Korean 16pt #FFFFFF + KPI value 24-32pt bold (e.g. '평균 ROE 11~12% 지향'). Left side: 3-4 horizontal strips (cyan numeral 01-04 ≈40pt #66FFFF + Korean label 14pt #FFFFFF, transparent fill + #14274A 1px border, year/phase label header 2024). Right side: same as left but 2025-2027 phase.
diagram.period_timeline_3col_with_badges_and_arr: p-65 mirror — comparison secondary. 3 columns equal ≈30%, ≈3% gap. Per column: year label top 48-56pt bold #FFFFFF (2024 / 2027 / 2030) → KPI metric 22pt bold #FFFFFF + #66FFFF emphasis (e.g. 'OP Margin 8~9%') → powertrain badges row (ICE muted gray #3A4150, HEV cyan #14274A, EREV mid-cyan #0060A8, EV bright #66FFFF — tonal rule strict, NO rainbow; ~40-50px diameter, label inside white bold 12pt) → bullet rationale 12-13pt #FFFFFF 80% 2-3 bullets. Between columns: #66FFFF 1.5-2pt STRAIGHT arrow left→right with filled arrowhead (distinct from curved diagram arrows). Title above: Korean bold 34pt #FFFFFF (e.g. '중장기 재무목표').
diagram.value_chain_3col_table_chevron_header: p-52 mirror — comparison primary. Header row y=18-22%: 3 chevron-tab trapezoidal headers (active fill #66FFFF + white text, inactive #14274A + #A8B4C8 text) labeled e.g. 'Upstream / Midstream / Downstream' bold 22pt. Optional subheader logo row y=25-30%. Subheader category row y=32-37%: per-column header (생산 / 운반 / 충전 / 활용), fill #00B0F0 or #14274A, white bold 16-18pt. Data rows 4-7: Korean 13-15pt #FFFFFF. ROW FILL alternating (even #14274A faint, odd transparent) OR horizontal hairline #14274A 1px ONLY. NO vertical column rule.
diagram.global_map_dark_with_callouts: p-22 mirror — diagram tertiary. Dark world-map underlay (#101030 base + #14274A country borders, NO grid, ≈80% opacity). 4-6 region callouts (US/Korea/Europe/India/CKD etc): flag icon ≈32-40px circle + white ring + region Korean bold 18pt #FFFFFF + Korean subtitle 12pt + mini bar/donut/numeric (e.g. '+30만대', '24/28 paired bar'). Emphasis region #66FFFF accent, others #FFFFFF + #0060A8. Anchored to geographic location; NO connecting lines.
diagram.hub_spoke_vehicle_center_3tier_bottom: p-35 mirror — diagram secondary. Center: vehicle front/3-4 view silhouette, #66FFFF wireframe glow, x=center y=30-65%, ≈40-50% canvas width. Bottom 3-tier chamfered platform y=75-92%: HW / SW / Service, each tier #14274A fill + #66FFFF top edge + white label. Left/right side cards (typically 2+2): rounded rectangle #14274A fill, Korean category bold 18pt + #66FFFF eyebrow 12pt. Curved #66FFFF 1.5-2pt arc arrows from cards to center vehicle (NOT straight lines). Top eyebrow y=18-22%: system name (e.g. '데이터 기반 SDV 고도화 선순환 체계') 22pt bold #FFFFFF centered with small chevron > markers each side.
diagram.render: SVG precise, no div blocks, stage-centered, minimal elements, NO drop shadow, NO neon outer-glow except chevron inner-V glow

modes.mode_A_chapter_slate_or_bookend: Full #101030 bg + chevron motif on one edge (LEFT 5-stack for cover/closing p-01/p-71, RIGHT 4-stack for single-word chapter slates p-02/p-58, RIGHT 2-3 arc + LEFT starburst for multi-word slates p-08) + giant English title (#FFFFFF for cover/closing, #66FFFF for chapter slates) + optional Korean subtitle (#FCFCFC) below. NO content blocks, NO charts. NO page number. NO running header.
modes.mode_B_body_content: Persistent top-left chevron+header mark + bottom-center page number + body title (left ~5% x, ~9% y) + eyebrow subtitle + content panel (chart / diagram / card grid / table / map / photo). 7 categories use Mode B: agenda / key-message / chart / diagram / cards / comparison / narrative.
modes.mode_C_sub_chapter_split: LEFT 50% darkened photographic panel + RIGHT 50% dark navy panel with English cyan eyebrow + Korean main title. Diagonal soft transition (~80°). Used as section secondary (p-17 mirror).

persistent_header_mark.presence: Every Mode B page (agenda / key-message / chart / diagram / cards / comparison / narrative)
persistent_header_mark.elements: (1) miniaturized 3-stack chevron glow at x≈3% (~50px wide, white-cyan inner V → #00B0F0 mid → #101030 outer fade) + (2) text '2024 CEO Investor Day' immediately right in #00B0F0 11-13pt Regular
persistent_header_mark.consistency: Identical x/y on every Mode B page — single most reliable signature feature. OMITTED on Mode A (cover/section/closing).

page_number.format: plain numeral '10' / '24' / '48' — NO fraction notation, NO decorative element
page_number.omit_on: Mode A (cover p-01 / chapter slates p-02·p-08·p-33·p-45·p-58 / closing p-71)

five_photo_treatments: (a) lower-half panoramic — p-18 style. y=55-100% wide panoramic of vehicle/road/factory, darkened to 60% opacity, soft top-gradient blend with bg. Used in key-message.

(b) inline cut-out industrial hero — p-09 style. Right 40% close-up industrial photo (engine block, battery pack, factory detail), translucent 50-70% opacity, blend with bg, slight right-bleed. Used in narrative.
(c) full-slide dim atmospheric underlay — p-26 style. Holographic person/factory/map underlay across full slide at ≤25% opacity. Used as supporting layer in agenda/cards.
(d) left-50% split panel — p-17/p-27/p-34/p-41 style. Left 50% darkened photo + right 50% dark panel. Used in section secondary (Mode C).
(e) logo/wordmark inline — p-14/p-15 style. Brand/wordmark inline next to category labels. Used in narrative secondary and key-message eyebrow row.
slide.photo_full_bleed_taboo: Single full-bleed photographic slides occupying 70-100% of canvas: 0 instances in deck. Photography always distributed via the 5 treatments above.
slide.transition: crossfade 0.5s | chevron motif fade-in 0.8s | giant KPI numeral count-up 0.6s | ∞ both lobes simultaneous fade-in 0.8s | NO fly-in / NO bounce / NO rotation

page_mirror_plan._doc: v3 핵심. 10 슬라이드 카테고리 ↔ 원본 페이지 1:1 매핑. anchor 페이지 양식을 그대로 따라 슬라이드를 만든다.

key_message.rule: main KPI is WHITE not cyan; cyan KPIs only inside cards

diagram.rule: infinity diagram: only 1 instance in entire deck (high-concept hero slot). #189078 teal used only here.

cards.rule: enumerator is SOLID fill NOT outline; same color across all cards (no per-card rainbow)

closing.rule: chevron position MATCHES cover (LEFT) — bookend symmetry

visual_vocabulary_dictionary._doc: v3 표준 어휘 24개. pptx-composer가 슬라이드 요소를 호출할 때 사용.

chevron_5stack_left.definition: 좌측 5-stack nested 우향 chevron, 폭 ~30%, 높이 ~80% 캔버스. 표지·종료의 bookend 양식.

chevron_4stack_right.definition: 우측 4-stack nested 우향 chevron, 높이 ~60%. 단어 1개 ALL CAPS 챕터 슬레이트.

chevron_3arc_right_plus_left_starburst.definition: 우측 2-3 arc nested chevron + 좌측 작은 cyan starburst horizontal flare. 다단어 Title Case 챕터 슬레이트.

chevron_miniature_header_mark.definition: 좌상단 x=3% y=4% ~50px 3-stack chevron + 옆 '2024 CEO Investor Day' #00B0F0 12pt.

infinity_two_lobe.definition: 수평 ∞ — 좌 blue lobe #0060A8→#002C5F + Mobility Game Changer / 우 teal lobe #189078→#0E5645 + Energy Mobilizer / 교차점 위 cyan label.

stage_chevron_tab_band.definition: 차트/표 위 3 trapezoidal chevron tabs 행, active 1개만 #66FFFF fill #101030 text.

kpi_hero_giant_white_plus_unit.definition: y=18-32% 거대 흰색 numeral 140-160pt + baseline-align 단위 45-55pt.

pill_row_3to4_short_label.definition: y=42-58% 3-4 rounded pill 카드 row, #14274A fill, 4:1 aspect, 흰 한글 bold 18-22pt 가운데.

card_grid_4plus3_asymmetric.definition: Row1 4 + Row2 3 비대칭 7카드 + 카드별 거대 cyan SOLID enumerator 01-07 80-100pt.

card_3col_icon_bullet.definition: 3 columns × (icon + Korean category bold 22-26pt + 5-7 bullet list 13-14pt).

card_4col_kpi_band.definition: 4 cards × (KPI numeral 64-72pt + unit 22pt + Korean label 14pt). 차량 underlay 가능.

narrative_4card_stack_plus_hero.definition: 좌 60% 4 카드 vertical stack (정확히 4개) + 우 40% 산업 사진 클로즈업 hero.

subchapter_50_50_photo_panel.definition: 좌 50% 어두운 사진 패널 + 우 50% 다크 패널 (cyan eyebrow + Korean main title). Mode C.

line_chart_cyan_with_stage_band.definition: 사이안 #00D3FD 2.5pt 라인 + 흰 fill cyan ring dots + 30% area fill cyan gradient + 상단 chevron-tab stage band.

stacked_bar_3tone_cyan.definition: 누적 막대 top #66FFFF / mid #00D3FD / base #0060A8 tonal stack. 비교 baseline #3A4A6E. NO rainbow.

donut_trio_isometric_stairs.definition: 3 도넛 mild isometric 계단 위 ascending (chamfered #14274A pedestal + #66FFFF top edge). 강조 segment #66FFFF→#00D3FD.

global_map_dark_with_callouts.definition: 다크 세계지도 underlay + 4-6 지역별 callout (국기 + 한글 라벨 + mini bar/도넛/수치). NO connecting lines.

hub_spoke_vehicle_center_3tier_bottom.definition: 중앙 차량 cyan wireframe + 좌우 사이드 카드 + 하단 HW/SW/Service 3-tier chamfered platform + 곡선 cyan 화살표.

three_circle_badge_invest_return_share.definition: 3 동일 원형 배지 가로 (~25% width each), #04599D fill + 2px #66FFFF ring + 영문 흰 bold + 한글 부제. NO per-badge color differentiation.

central_hub_plus_radiating_callouts.definition: 중앙 라운드 KPI hub (#0060A8 또는 #14274A + #66FFFF outline) + 좌우 numbered horizontal strip callouts (numeral 01-04 #66FFFF 40pt).

period_timeline_3col_with_badges_and_arr.definition: 2024/2027/2030 3-col × (year + KPI + powertrain 배지 tonal + bullets) + 좌→우 직선 화살표.

value_chain_3col_table_chevron_header.definition: Upstream/Midstream/Downstream chevron-tab 헤더 + 5-row data table, horizontal hairline only, NO vertical column rule.

thank_you_cover_mirror.definition: 좌측 5-stack chevron (표지 mirror) + 우측 'THANK YOU' 영문 ALL CAPS bold 72-80pt #FFFFFF. NO header mark, NO page number.

brand_recap_3badge_circle.definition: 3 사업영역 배지 (완성차/모빌리티/수소에너지) 모두 동일 #04599D 계열 fill + #66FFFF ring + HYUNDAI 워드마크 우하단.

values_4badge_radial_gradient.definition: 4 attribute 배지 (Safety/Agility/Tenacity/Progress) soft cyan radial gradient #66FFFF→#0060A8 fill + 거대 영문 헤드라인 48-56pt.

pages.label: 표지 — 좌측 5-stack chevron + 우측 흰색 '2024 CEO Investor Day' (헤더 마크·페이지 번호 없음)
아젠다 — 좌 35% pill stack + 우 60% 컨텍스트 메시지 + 차량 underlay (본문 mode B)
메인 챕터 슬레이트 — 우측 4-stack chevron + 사이안 영문 타이틀 #66FFFF + (다단어 시) 한글 부제. p-17 sub-chapter 양식 secondary.
거대 KPI 히어로 — 흰색 numeral 140-160pt + 단위 + 3-pill row + 하단 panoramic 차량
라인 차트 + Chevron-tab 단계 헤더 (수소 시장 양식) — 사이안 단색 패밀리 tonal
HYUNDAI WAY ∞ 인피니티 — 컨셉 아키텍처 hero (deck 전체 단 1번)
카드 enumerator 그리드 — 4+3 비대칭 7카드, 거대 사이안 SOLID 숫자 01~07
밸류체인 3-col 테이블 + chevron-tab 헤더 — horizontal hairline only
narrative — 좌 60% 4-card stack + 우 40% 산업 사진 클로즈업 hero
클로징 — 좌측 5-stack chevron 미러 + 우측 'THANK YOU' 흰색 영문 (헤더 마크·페이지 번호 없음)
